description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the office of the Chairman of the Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for the office of Chairman in a local government authority (Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedural steps triggered by a vacancy due to death and the subsequent declaration of a newly elected Chairman by the Returning Officer. The core subject is an electoral process at the local government level, falling squarely under the definition of **Elections Gazettes (Type 7)**, which includes candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations related to electoral processes.
